remarks: Beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath ranch nestled in the highly desirable neighborhood of West Norwalk. This home features convenient one-level living with an open floor plan, gleaming hardwood floors and thoughtful modern updates throughout. Step into a bright and inviting living room that exudes warmth and comfort, highlighted by a wood burning fireplace that serves as a cozy focal point. The kitchen features granite countertops, updated cabinetry, and a breakfast bar that opens to a spacious dining area--ideal for both every day living and entertaining. French doors open to a private deck, offering a peaceful view of the beautifully maintained backyard--perfect for relaxing or hosting guests. The primary bedroom serves as a private retreat, complete with a convenient half bath and a spacious walk-in closet. Additional highlights include a partially finished basement with space ideal for a home gym, recreation area, or future customization to suit your needs. A spacious two-car garage offers ample storage and convenience. This home blends charm with functionality in a prime location close to local amenities and shopping, with nearby access to major highways for an easy commute--An exceptional opportunity not to be missed!
